name: The Persian Qanat
description: Beneath Iran's deserts runs a hidden network of gently sloping tunnels, some about 3,000 years old, that carry groundwater from the foothills to villages and fields without any pumps. From above, you see lines of well-like shafts dotting the barren ground. This listing covers eleven qanats, with watermills, reservoirs and worker rest areas, still shared among communities.
